name: Setext
summary: Early lightweight plain-text markup ("structure-enhanced text") used to publish the TidBITS newsletter from 1992: underlined titles and subheads, **bold**, ~italic~, _underlined_ words and indented text, readable as-is and convertible to rich formats. A direct ancestor of reStructuredText and Markdown (whose "setext-style" underlined headings keep its name).

level_notes.1: The original bsdi.com setext documents (Feldman's "setext sermons", setext_concepts) survive only in archives and in the Docutils mirror (docutils.sourceforge.io, which blocks automated checks).
level_notes.0: No original implementation survives online; Erik Oliver's setext2html Perl converter is a later reconstruction.
